result.summary: Fixed a bug in Sources/RingBuffer/RingBuffer.swift:18-26 (append). When the buffer was full, append overwrote storage[head] (the oldest slot) but never advanced head, so head kept pointing at the just-written element and element ordering was wrong. Added an else branch that advances head = (head + 1) % capacity when the buffer is full. Verified: `swift test --build-system native --disable-sandbox` from the repo root now exits 0 with all 4 tests passing (testAppendBelowCapacity, testOverwriteDropsOldest, testRemoveFirstAfterWrap, testReuseAfterDrain). No test files were modified.
